title: Dinteville (Langres) to the Duke of Nevers, 3 July 1592, BnF Français 3621 no. 116 f. 130 (DECODE R9451)

documents.shelfmark: BnF Français 3621 no. 116 f. 130 (DECODE R9451; Gallica btv1b52524472n view 269)

plaintext.source: No decipherment on the leaf despite the DECODE note; postscript is clear French

transcription.source: Gallica view 269 and DECODE image; not transcribed in full

documents.shelfmark: BnF Français 3621 f. 128 (Gallica view 265), probably no. 114

plaintext.source: Contemporary decipherment written above each cipher line

transcription.source: Gallica view 265; one line (50 signs) transcribed by eye

system.summary: Letter-and-sign substitution with apparent code signs for words; a one-sign-one-letter homophonic mapping does not fit the f. 128 crib.
system.sibling_key: f. 128 of the same volume, same sign set, with interlinear decipherment
system.notes: Dots follow some signs; the decipherer wrote + and | for unexpanded signs.

solution.what: DECODE R9451 image fetched with cookie; fr. 3621 found on Gallica (btv1b52524472n), ff. 127-131 viewed.
Checked f. 130 for the contemporary decipherment DECODE mentions: none; the postscript is clear French.
Found f. 128, a sibling Dinteville letter in the same signs with interlinear decipherment.
Transcribed 50 signs of the f. 128 second cipher line by eye.
One-sign-one-letter homophonic mapping with up to three null types, aligned to the interlinear (align.py).

outcome.method_basis: f. 130 (DECODE R9451) has no decipherment; a sibling letter on f. 128 with an interlinear decipherment was found as a crib, but a one-sign-one-letter alignment of 50 hand-transcribed signs failed and no key was rebuilt.
outcome.notes: Crib found on f. 128 but key not rebuilt; needs a careful sign transcription of ff. 128 and 130.
